title: Level 4 (Expert) - C-5
notes:
West leads the ♥Q against 3NT. West is marked with a spade void by East's preempt. There are only 6 top tricks (the ♠A, 2 hearts, the ♦A, and 2 clubs). South's only hope is to reach dummy's clubs. Unfortunately, dummy is greatly lacking in entries.

South must hope to duck a spade trick to East when East has only spades left. East will be forced to give dummy the lead with the ♠Q and the clubs can be cashed.

The opening lead should be won and South should unblock clubs. A diamond trick should be ducked. If the defense continues diamonds, South can afford to duck. South can win any return, cash any remaining red suit winners, and duck a spade trick to East. East will be down to all spades and his return will allow South to reach dummy's clubs.
